zh: 优化触屏设备侧边栏会话列表排版（在 hover: none 下分离时间、置顶图标与操作菜单间距，避免重叠）；同时包含移动端交互式审批卡片（支持本对话完全访问授权与高危操作确认）及持久化用户专属工作区。
en: Refined touch-device sidebar conversation row layout (separating timestamps, pin icons, and action menus under hover: none to prevent overlap), alongside interactive mobile approval cards with one-tap chat-level full access and persistent user-owned workspaces.
